patch.summary: InboxAlly migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to InboxAlly by inventorying legacy email-marketing fields, mapping them to InboxAlly objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating HubSpot, Klaviyo before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Not a campaign platform — complements an ESP
Success signal: automation workflows works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: InboxAlly migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power automation workflows and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into InboxAlly; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate HubSpot; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Senders with damaged domain reputation outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Not a campaign platform — complements an ESP
If InboxAlly mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Bouncer before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire HubSpot in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Not a campaign platform — complements an ESP

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Pricing scales steeply with sender profiles and seed volume

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Requires including seed addresses in sends

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for automation workflows
Mitigate: Not a campaign platform — complements an ESP
